about: pairing tolerance below the gauge's reporting interval
text: Seen while exploring. Pairing within 5 minutes keeps 31 of 52 passes, because the gauge reports every 15 minutes; 15 minutes keeps 50 and 60 minutes keeps all 52 with the same spread (0.298 m and 0.293 m) and, with the flag screen, a gain of 1.0121 and 1.0115. A tolerance tighter than the gauge interval only throws passes away.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
